subject: Final MAP: exit-latch, procurement cadence, and day-one commencement
messages:
From: Marcus Doyle <mdoyle@edgewave.com>
To: markus.klein@redwoodinference.com
Cc: priya.shah@edgewave.com, sandra.legal@edgewave.com
Date: Thu, 14 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Final MAP and timing — ready to lock if procurement clears

Markus,

Thanks again for walking the team through the evaluation last week. Per our MAP workshop, attached is the edited MAP (EdgeWave_MAP_v2.pdf) with the final evaluation milestones, pilot acceptance criteria, and the proposed go/no-go checkpoint two business days before start.

We're aligned internally on the technical acceptance but procurement needs an explicit signature and PO schedule from you to kick the vendor checks and insurance verification. Two asks:

- Can Redwood prepare the SOW + DocuSign envelope for countersign by next Tue (6/20)?
- If procurement confirms a PO by 6/28, can we target a 7/1 day-one start for the pilot ramp?

Sandra (legal) and Priya (procurement) are looped for process. Attaching the MAP so we have the same doc.

Thanks,
Marcus
Marcus Doyle
VP Product, EdgeWave Systems

Attachment: EdgeWave_MAP_v2.pdf (application/pdf)
From: markus.klein@redwoodinference.com
To: Marcus Doyle <mdoyle@edgewave.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com, laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 14 Jun 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Final MAP and timing — ready to lock if procurement clears

Marcus — thanks for the MAP and the clear tempo. We can execute to the timelines you propose with two coordination items on our side:

1) SOW + DocuSign: I'll have SOW_EdgeWave_v1.docx out to you for review by EOD Friday (6/16). We'll create a single envelope for signature (Account-level SOW + MAP as attachment).
2) VP approval for an SLA exception: Because your pilot has a higher-than-normal retention window, I need a quick VP sign-off for the SLA carve (internal). If we get that by Mon (6/18) the DocuSign window and PO cadence should align to your 7/1 start target.

Proposed next steps (mutual action plan items):
- Fri 6/16: Redwood sends SOW + envelope draft to EdgeWave legal
- Mon 6/18: Redwood confirms SLA exception or provides alternate retention config
- Tue 6/20: EdgeWave countersign via DocuSign
- Wed 6/28: EdgeWave issues PO / procurement clears vendor check
- Mon 7/1: Day-one pilot start (config + onboarding session)

Kimberly — can you prepare the SOW and the envelope? Laura — I'll need the VP approval note once you have it.

Cheers,
Markus Klein
Head of Sales — Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference

Attachment: SOW_EdgeWave_v1.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@edgewave.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com, markus.klein@redwoodinference.com
Cc: sandra.legal@edgewave.com, mdoyle@edgewave.com
Date: Mon, 18 Jun 2028 10:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Final MAP and timing — ready to lock if procurement clears

Hi Kimberly / Markus —

Procurement update from our side: we can process a PO by 6/28 provided the following are in place by 6/22:

- Completed vendor form (W-9 + insurance cert) — attached is our filled vendor form (Vendor_Form_EdgeWave_filled.pdf) for Redwood to confirm you've received and accepted the details.
- Final SOW with a clear billing cadence and contact for invoices
- DocuSign envelope with signer order (we require legal then procurement on our side)

We have one constraint: our legal team needs the signature deadline to remain open for 5 business days to allow countersign review. If Redwood needs faster turnaround, flag and we'll try to compress, but budget/process likely needs the 5-day window.

Thanks — Priya
Procurement Manager, EdgeWave Systems

Attachment: Vendor_Form_EdgeWave_filled.pdf (application/pdf)
From: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@edgewave.com>, Marcus Doyle <mdoyle@edgewave.com>
Cc: markus.klein@redwoodinference.com, laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 19 Jun 2028 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Final MAP and timing — ready to lock if procurement clears

Thanks Priya — copying the procurement asks into the envelope. A couple of operational notes for transparency:

- I created the DocuSign envelope and set signer order to: EdgeWave legal -> EdgeWave procurement -> Redwood Sales -> Redwood Legal. Link below.
- We usually allow a 7-day signing window by default; we can shorten to 5 days to match your process if your legal confirms the expectation.
- For billing cadence, Redwood will issue the first invoice on activation (Day 1) and then monthly thereafter unless you require net-30 on the PO. Please confirm billing terms for the SOW.

DocuSign link: https://app.docusign.com/envelope/ABC123XYZ

Markus — on the SLA exception: I've drafted a one-paragraph carve that limits the retention to 90 days for the pilot; Laura, can you review and escalate to VP ops for the sign-off? If we get that cleared by Mon 6/25, we'll keep the rest of the timeline intact.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Sr. Contracts Manager, Redwood Inference
From: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
To: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com, markus.klein@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 28 Jun 2028 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Final MAP and timing — ready to lock if procurement clears

Kimberly / Markus —

I've reviewed the proposed carve and have secured exec approval to make the 90-day retention exception for the EdgeWave pilot. Approval memo attached (Exec_Approval_20280628.pdf). Conditions:

- The exception applies only to the pilot scope listed in SOW_EdgeWave_v1; any expanded production usage will revert to standard retention unless renewed in writing.
- Invoice hold will be released once we receive the PO and insurance cert (per Priya's note).

With approval confirmed, please proceed with the envelope and keep the signing order intact. If EdgeWave can get signatures in the DocuSign window and issue PO by 6/28, Redwood will allocate onboarding resources for a 7/1 start.

Laura Bennett
VP, Customer Success Operations, Redwood Inference

Attachment: Exec_Approval_20280628.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Marcus Doyle <mdoyle@edgewave.com>
To: markus.klein@redwoodinference.com, kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com, laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 29 Jun 2028 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Final MAP and timing — ready to lock if procurement clears

Team — quick update from procurement: PO 450-2028-EW has been issued and the DocuSign envelope was completed this morning by our legal and procurement leads. Sandra (legal) countersigned at 15:42 PT. DocuSign record: https://app.docusign.com/envelope/ABC123XYZ/view.

We're green to go for a 2028-07-01 pilot start. Marcus (ops) will reach out to schedule the day-one onboarding slot for configuration and test dataset ingest.

Appreciate the responsiveness — excited to get started.

Marcus

Attachment: PO_450-2028-EW.pdf (application/pdf)
